correctness.rationale: Exact double-star characteristic polynomials order all hub-edge alternatives and all central-vs-leaf pendant reattachments; the Schur-complement resolvent comparison is strictly positive for all parameters with both base hub-leaf sets nonempty, while one-leaf boundaries are handled by explicit isomorphisms. Standalone exhaustive enumeration covers 19,565 valid graph exchanges from 78 parameter pairs and exact matching-polynomial checks cover 112 cases. The infinite theorem rests on the proof, not finite tests.

value.rationale: Edgewise spectral sustainability explicitly motivates the number and identity of nondecreasing reattachments. This theorem determines the entire labelled single-edge exchange spectrum on all double stars, and exhibits distinct strict/neutral phases at zero, one, and larger hub-leaf imbalance; only hub-edge failure was published in the closest source. The exact natural local robustness classification can act as a structural base case for spectral tree-shift studies.
